# Induced Mutiny [bold]Induced Mutiny[/bold] is any mutiny induced by mind-altering or mind-controlling technologies, usually administered by one or more hostile infiltrators.
Previously experienced examples of these are:
- USSP mind-control technologies, used to instigate revolution. - Arcane mind-control, employed by some cult organizations - Mind-controlling implants
The presence of these infiltrators, or their victims, can in some cases be confirmed via implantation of a [color=lightblue]NanoTrasen-brand Mindshield™[/color].
- Should the implantation be rejected by the body and fail, this is indicative of a [bold][color=red]hostile infiltrator[/color][/bold]. - Should the implanted crewmember suddenly forget what happened prior to the implantation, this is indicative of a [bold][color=lightblue]mind-control victim[/color][/bold].
In cases where mindshielding produces no results, despite clear signs of mind-control, the following may be attempted:
- Consultation with the station's [color=#FFFAAF][bold]Chaplain[/bold][/color], to determine arcane or spiritual influences. - Consultation with a Medical Professional, to determine the presence of a mind-altering implant or substance.
An Induced Mutiny can furthermore be assumed to be in effect if the enemy infiltrator tips their hand, for example by:
- Deploying a teleportation beacon or rift, to supply weapons to the mutineers. - Equipping the mutineers with clear displays of allegiance, such as uniforms or arcane sigils.
If an Induced Mutiny is confirmed to be underfoot, either via a mindshielding or via open declaration, then Security is legally allowed to demand the mindshielding of any crewmember, for their own safety. Refusal of these demands is a Capital Offense under [textlink="Corporate Law" link="CorporateLaw"].
Any crewmembers upon who the mindshielding fails is still guilty of Refusal of Mindshielding, whether they actually refused or not, and should be executed.
As long as a mind-shield is able to restore the victims' original state, they should not be prosecuted for actions committed while under said mind-control, including any refusal of mindshielding.
